exam_facts.test: Contrast-enhanced MRI of the face and neck
exam_facts.result: Well-circumscribed, irregularly marginated T2-hyperintense, T1-isointense ulcerative lesion measuring 1.3 × 0.9 × 0.6 cm centered at the mid-portion of the lower lip vermillion border, with superficial soft tissue infiltration extending into the underlying orbicularis oris muscle but not crossing the mental crease inferiorly; no involvement of mandibular bone cortex; no pathologic cervical lymph nodes (all submental, submandibular, and upper jugular nodes <1.0 cm short axis, round morphology, preserved fatty hilum)

exam_facts.test: High-resolution ultrasound of bilateral cervical lymph node levels I–V
exam_facts.result: No abnormal nodes: all nodes have oval shape, short-to-long axis ratio >0.5, central echogenic hilum, no cortical thickening or loss of hilum, no increased vascularity on Doppler; largest node in right submandibular region measures 0.7 × 0.4 cm
